scope: Read substantive prose across the main page, seven branches and 63 individual parable/teaching-image studies; inspected 14 current art captions; structurally checked citation-token bounds and six-collection coverage. This is independent editorial/source-consistency review, not a new live verification of every external source URL or a browser test.

findings.issue: The branch promises connected complete parable studies, but its nine sections and four related cards contain no internal links to any of the six parable collections or the individual parables. The individual pages link back through this branch, yet the branch does not provide the forward path.
findings.required_action: Insert the six-theme collection directory into this branch during integration and verify all collection routes are reachable from the main Jesus Christ journey.
findings.evidence: All six collection URLs are present in parable-collections-reviewed.json; all 63 individual studies are linked from collection cards. Missing edge is teachings branch to collections.

findings.issue: Prepared main content currently contains nine Christ-story illustrations and six modern illustrations. The accepted outline called for fifteen Christ-story pictures plus six modern pictures. Before-Bethlehem and saving-mission sections presently contain no art blocks, so the planned whole-life illustrated arc is concentrated in a smaller set of mortal encounters.
findings.required_action: Ensure final integrated main page supplies the agreed fifteen Christ-story illustrations, with meaningful pictures spanning the premortal/Old Testament and Resurrection/living-Christ portions, or document an explicit owner-approved scope change. Existing correctly owned and approved art may satisfy part of this if actually integrated.
findings.evidence: Christ keys: come-and-see, nathanael, syrophoenician-woman, deaf-man, ten-lepers-thanksgiving, tribute-coin, widows-offering, rich-man-invitation, martha-and-mary. Six separate modern keys are present.
findings.stage_boundary: This finding concerns the supplied main-content data. It does not assume an eventual assembled page cannot add further reviewed content.

substantive_assessment.doctrinal_clarity: No material contradiction identified in the reviewed prose. Premortal Christ, distinction from the Father, divine creation, Jehovah, mortal ministry, willing suffering, bodily Resurrection, Book of Mormon witness and Restoration testimony are presented coherently within the stated Latter-day Saint perspective.
substantive_assessment.evidence_boundaries: Accounts are generally kept distinct: Andrew's first meeting versus later fishing calls; centurion messengers in Luke; different blind-man healings; Mary of Bethany versus Mary Magdalene; revived mortal life versus permanent Resurrection; Ether premortal appearance; Joseph F. Smith vision date versus the earlier ministry revealed; Liberty Jail revelation versus visible appearance.
substantive_assessment.pastoral_claims: No unsupported promise of guaranteed healing, immediate reconciliation, financial return, automatic relief of grief or predicted Second Coming date found. Disability, bereavement and hardship are not equated with moral failure. Parable applications preserve human agency and distinguish personal reflection from reported events.
substantive_assessment.parable_completeness_boundary: The corpus contains 63 separate parable/comparison studies, including conventional narrative parables, short sayings and Johannine extended images. This count should be described using that scope rather than a universal claim that all scholars identify precisely 63 parables. The reviewed text explicitly distinguishes talents/minas, royal wedding/great supper, barren/budding fig, and Good Shepherd allegory terminology.
substantive_assessment.captions: Current art-batch-3 captions fit reviewed visible content and do not claim absent ear/tongue-touch gestures, invented coin customs or a completed sorrowful departure. Artistic reconstructions are identified where important. No blocking caption issue identified.

release_verification_remaining: Integrate and check the missing forward parable-directory path.
Check final main artwork count and distribution against agreed scope.
Verify assembled pages, actual href targets, browser study dialogs and return navigation independently; content review cannot establish those runtime outcomes.
overall: Substantive prose is suitable to proceed into assembly, with two concrete integration/scope findings to resolve before declaring the agreed journey complete. No content edits performed.
